posts.text: I don’t skip workouts—I just forget they existed. Anyone else?
“Just focus” is the ADHD equivalent of “have you tried turning your brain off and on again?”
The wildest part of ADHD diagnosis in adulthood? Realizing how much grace you deserved sooner.
ADHD hack: gamify everything. Beat the clock, not yourself.
ADHD recovery isn’t about perfection — it’s about permission to rest. This hit hard.
ADHD means loves new ideas but hates follow-through but hey, it keeps life interesting.
